verdict.rationale: A payments and stablecoin product processes customer and transaction data, so an AI-training opt-out or data-use control is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI-training opt-outs, data-use policies, or controls over model training. The MCP, sandbox and llms.txt items cover developer tooling, not data-use controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
